sentences.text: Speaker D said programmed functions should be in a separate place and not all the on buttons together because then you don't know what you're turning on. [c001]
Speaker B said more complicated functions could be saved for separate remotes that you wouldn't need to use every day. [c003]
Speaker A proposed one remote with main functions on off channel changing volume and another remote with special things needed occasionally. [c004]
